Name: }bedrock.migrate.process
DataProcedure:
#****Begin: Generated Statements***
#****End: Generated Statements****

vProcess = JsonToString( vProcess );
#################################################################################################
#Region - Execute Http Requests to Migrate Process

# Get the Process's JSON
ExecuteProcess('}bedrock.process.execute_http_request',
  'pMethod', 'GET',
  'pURL', sSourceURL | '/Processes('''|URLEncode( vProcess )|''')?$select=*',
  'pHeaders', JsonAdd( JsonAdd( sSrcAuthHeaders, '', '"Content-Type:application/json; charset=utf-8"' ), '', '"Accept: application/json;odata.metadata=none,text/plain"' ),
  'pJson', pJson );
sProcessJson = JsonGet( sBedrockReturnValue, '/body' );
IF( SCAN( '"@odata.context"', sProcessJson ) <> 0 );
  sProcessJson = JsonRemove( sProcessJson, '/@odata.context' );
ENDIF;

# Create the Process
ExecuteProcess('}bedrock.process.execute_http_request',
  'pMethod', 'POST',
  'pURL', sTargetURL | '/Processes',
  'pHeaders', JsonAdd( JsonAdd( sTgtAuthHeaders, '', '"Content-Type:application/json; charset=utf-8"' ), '', '"Accept: application/json;odata.metadata=none,text/plain"' ),
  'pBody', sProcessJson,
  'pJson', pJson );

#EndRegion - Execute Http Requests to Migrate Process
#################################################################################################

Parameters.Name: pProcess
Parameters.Prompt: REQUIRED: Process name, wildcard pattern, '&'-separated list, or JSON Array of names/patterns

Parameters.Name: pSourceDatabaseName
Parameters.Prompt: REQUIRED: Source connection name in }bedrock.session.start, or a connection-details JSON object returned by it

Parameters.Name: pTargetDatabaseName
Parameters.Prompt: REQUIRED: Target connection name in }bedrock.session.start, or a connection-details JSON object returned by it

Parameters.Name: pIncludeControlObjects
Parameters.Prompt: OPTIONAL: Include control objects (names starting with }) that match the pattern (Boolean. Default = 0)

Parameters.Name: pLogOutput
Parameters.Prompt: OPTIONAL: Write parameters and action summary to server message log (Boolean. Default = 0)

Parameters.Name: pStrictErrorHandling
Parameters.Prompt: OPTIONAL: On encountering any error, exit with major error status by ProcessQuit after writing to the server message log (Boolean. Default = 0)

Parameters.Name: pJson
Parameters.Prompt: OPTIONAL: JSON Object with process parameter values. This will overwrite user passed parameters for all included parameters.
